notes.title: Update for Bug Fixes.
notes.content:
CHANGES
- Fixed a bug where certain character movements were not correctly reflected in the sprites
- Fixed a bug relating to text overflows in the History in Traditional and Simplified Chinese
- Fixed a bug in Simplified Chinese that caused CGs to be displayed too long
- Adjusted Simplified Chinese translation.
* This update is compatible with existing save files.
